The desk runs in the browser. Models produce signals across 8 assets, the broker partner holds funds, and the platform charges no fee of its own - spreads and overnight charges still apply.

We read every public page - the pricing notes, the restriction lists, the support claims and the disclosures - and scored the platform on ease of use, features, transparency, security and support. The verdict below is our own.
whatItClaims: 8 crypto assets through broker partners.
A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$300 minimum deposit to start.
whatWeChecked: The risk disclosure: where the capital-at-risk wording sits.
The security claims: encryption and account protection statements.
The withdrawal path: steps and any fees the page omits.
The ownership trail: who operates the platform and where.
The support channels: live chat, email or phone availability.
The fine print: clauses that qualify the headline promises.

steps.title: Register

steps.text: Complete the US$300 deposit to unlock the live dashboard.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set your limits, pick a trading mode and let the demo build your confidence first.

pros: Funding by card, transfer, PayPal and Skrill.
cons: The headline fee claim and the real cost disagree.
redFlags: A broker relationship described in one vague sentence.
Ownership details missing from the public pages.
The demo promised in the pitch but buried in the flow.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$300 minimum.

faqs.q: Which assets can I trade?
faqs.a: 8 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: What is the minimum deposit?
faqs.a: US$300, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

faqs.q: Is registration free?
faqs.a: Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$300 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.

bottomLine: The verdict on the product is cautious approval: it works, it includes a demo, and it should be used with the minimum deposit while the claims are unproven.
The scorecard settles at 4.2. That is a cautious pass - proceed with the demo first, the minimum deposit second, and treat every payout figure as unproven until you see it yourself.
